title: Archive Doodle Index
blurb: All 345 Quick, Draw! categories matched to archive shots by the archive's own image search.

title: Doodle to Footage
blurb: Drawings and footage in one CLIP space once each modality's mean is removed; stepping-stone matches to inspect.

title: Cartoon Archive
blurb: SAM finds the subject in nearly every frame, but outlines traced from masks do not look drawn.

title: Giraffe Walks Past
blurb: One shot rebuilt as a multiplane cartoon: rotoscoped keys, six depth planes, the real camera pan, three blind reviews.

title: Selected Drawings
blurb: An image model held a doodle identity across four keys for ten subjects, one critic-named gap per round.

title: Traced Keys
blurb: Every raster key traced into pen strokes without losing a mark; the traces show backgrounds redrawn per key.

title: Pipeline
blurb: Thirteen stages from archive shot to cartoon: what each reads, writes and must pass.

title: Agent Prompt
blurb: Hands one subject to an agent: how to work, the bars it may not lower, what it may claim.

title: Test Rack
blurb: Every test, active and planned, against every lot that has run it.
